# XO-9: Honorport Heist — Participant Briefing

Welcome to **Honorport**, Doctor Doom's sovereign autonomous logistics & cargo depot.

## Challenge Objective
Interrogate the Honorport Logistics Console, investigate container deployment mechanisms, and gain authorized access to the Honorport High-Security Mainframe Vault to capture the flag.

## Access Details
- **Web Interface:** `http://<TARGET_HOST>:8080/`
- **SSH Gateway:** `ssh honorport@<TARGET_HOST> -p 22`

## Guidelines
- All infrastructure components operate strictly within the provided sandbox environment.
- Do not attempt Denial of Service or attacks against event infrastructure.
